title: Password ssh returns sshpass_missing — use a key or the fallback path
symptom: launch_cli.py ssh ends with sshpass_missing (password logins need sshpass)
cause: The saved server uses password login, but sshpass is not installed. Key login (key_path) does not need sshpass
fix: With a key: launch_cli.py ssh --cred <server> --key-path <key file> --command '<command>'
Ask the user before installing sshpass: brew install hudochenkov/sshpass/sshpass
Where it cannot be installed (Windows, etc.), use pro-ssh's scripts/ssh_connect.py (paramiko) — skills/pro-ssh/SKILL.md
